This is a post with executable code.

```{r}
#| warning: false
#| message: false

library(tidyverse)
library(gt)


```

```{r}
head(iris) |> 
        gt() |> 
        tab_header(
                title = "Big title",
                subtitle = "Small one"
        ) |> 
        tab_style(
                style = cell_text(color = "blue", weight = "bold"),
                locations = cells_title(groups = "title")
        ) |> 
        tab_style(
                style = cell_fill(color = "grey90"),
                locations = cells_body(rows = seq(1, 6, 2))
        ) |> 
        tab_options(
                column_labels.background.color = "steelblue",
                heading.align = "left")
```
